title: Zanzibar Octopus Salad
community: Zanzibar — the tidal flat harvest transformed into a salad
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Zanzibar Saladi ya Pweza — tenderised octopus sliced and tossed with tomatoes, red onion, cucumber, coriander, and a lime-garlic-chilli dressing. The elegant Zanzibar octopus salad — a lighter, fresher preparation than the curry, showcasing the tidal flat catch at its most refined.
longDesc: Octopus salad is Zanzibar's most refreshing seafood preparation — the tenderised octopus is sliced and served cold or at room temperature in a vibrant lime dressing. The same octopus that goes into the rich curry here reveals a completely different character: clean, light, and briny.
ingredients: 600g fresh octopus — tenderised and simmered until just tender
¼ red onion — very thinly sliced
steps: Tenderise octopus (freeze-thaw or pound). Simmer in plain water 25—30 minutes until tender. Cool completely.
Combine octopus, tomato, cucumber, red onion, and chilli.
Serve at room temperature or chilled.
chefTips: Do not overdress — the octopus flavour should dominate.
cookingScience: See TZA065 for octopus tenderisation science.
sustainabilityTips: Zanzibar tidal flat octopus from local women fishers.
culturalNote: Octopus salad is Zanzibar's most elegant seafood preparation — the same catch that the women bring in from the tidal flats, prepared with the lightness and restraint that shows its quality most clearly.
